```yaml
name: Regression Tests

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  build-and-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        python-version: [3.8, 3.9, 3.10, 3.11]
        test-group: [fast, network, slow, core]
    
    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v2
    
    - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
      uses: actions/setup-python@v2
      with:
        python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
    
    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        python -m pip install --upgrade pip
        pip install -r requirements.txt
    
    - name: Run tests
      run: |
        pytest -m "not regression" --junitxml=results.xml tests/${{ matrix.test-group }}/
    
    - name: Upload test results
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v2
      with:
        name: test-results-${{ matrix.python-version }}-${{ matrix.test-group }}
        path: results.xml

  regression-tests:
    needs: build-and-test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    
    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v2
    
    - name: Set up Python 3.x
      uses: actions/setup-python@v2
      with:
        python-version: '3.x'
    
    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        python -m pip install --upgrade pip
        pip install -r requirements.txt
    
    - name: Run regression tests
      run: |
        pytest -m regression --junitxml=regression-results.xml
    
    - name: Upload regression test results
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v2
      with:
        name: regression-results
        path: regression-results.xml
```

This GitHub Actions workflow file defines two jobs:

1. `build-and-test`: This job runs on multiple Python versions (3.8, 3.9, 3.10, 3.11) and test groups (fast, network, slow, core). It checks out the code, sets up the specified Python version, installs dependencies, runs tests excluding regression tests, and uploads the test results as artifacts.

2. `regression-tests`: This job depends on the `build-and-test` job and runs after all other jobs have completed. It checks out the code, sets up Python 3.x, installs dependencies, runs regression tests, and uploads the regression test results as an artifact.

The workflow is triggered on pushes and pull requests to the `main` branch. The `needs` keyword ensures that the `regression-tests` job waits for all jobs in the `build-and-test` matrix to complete before running.
